+def _fsync_directory(directory: str) -> None:
+    """
+    Best-effort fsync of a directory, so that a rename inside it is durable.
+    Silently does nothing on platforms that do not support it.
+    """
+
+    try:
+        fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
+    except OSError:
+        return
+
+    try:
+        os.fsync(fd)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+
